lessons.title: The Input Manager
lessons.description: Discover Unity's built-in input system, the Input Manager, and how it maps keys, buttons, and axes to actions.

lessons.title: Keyboard Input
lessons.description: Read key presses, holds, and releases using GetKey, GetKeyDown, GetKeyUp, and the KeyCode enum.

lessons.title: Axis Input & Smoothing
lessons.description: Master GetAxis and GetAxisRaw for continuous movement, understand input gravity and sensitivity.

lessons.title: Mouse & Gamepad
lessons.description: Work with mouse position, delta, buttons, and discover gamepad support through axes and buttons.

lessons.title: Player Movement in 2D & 3D
lessons.description: Build complete player controllers using Transform and Rigidbody, combining input with physics.
